title: Classification required in definitions
objective: Schema columns, event fields, API fields and document types must declare classification and regulated-category tags; the build fails on missing tags; derived projections inherit the maximum classification of their sources.
owner: Data governance owner (proposed role; not appointed)
residual_risks: Free-text fields can contain any class of data regardless of their declared classification.

title: Classification-aware tool and export permissions
objective: Agent tools, export jobs and outbound channels declare the maximum classification they may carry; the gateway refuses payloads containing fields above that level.
owner: Data governance owner (proposed role; not appointed)
residual_risks: Classification of free text is uncertain; pattern detection is probabilistic.

title: Labeled document rendering
objective: Folio templates render a classification label and embed classification metadata in every generated document and export.
owner: Data governance owner (proposed role; not appointed)

title: Tokenization vault for restricted identifiers
objective: Restricted identifiers exist in plaintext only inside a tokenization vault with field-level encryption under managed keys; all other components store tokens; detokenization is a purpose-scoped, logged call.
owner: Data governance owner (proposed role; not appointed)
residual_risks: Payment file generation requires plaintext at the moment of transmission.

title: Restricted-pattern scanning on logs, events and prompts
objective: Log, event append and model gateway paths scan for account-number, SSN and TIN patterns and reject or redact before persistence.
implementing_systems: Unbound event append service and model gateway (not built)
owner: Data governance owner (proposed role; not appointed)
residual_risks: Pattern detection has false negatives and false positives.

title: Single typed disclosure path for donor identity
objective: Outbound templates and integrations receive donor identity only as a typed DisclosedIdentity produced by applying the grant's preference; raw donor name types cannot be passed to outbound renderers.
owner: Data governance owner (proposed role; not appointed)
residual_risks: Third-party grant platforms may display data they hold independently.

title: Collection-need register gate
objective: Schema fields tagged personal must reference a collection-need entry (purpose, legal basis or contract need, owner); integration contracts declare outbound fields; CI fails on undeclared fields.
owner: Data governance owner (proposed role; not appointed)
